tsa-a11-v01.quick_english: Thus, as far as this has been stated — direct for someone's attainment-of-release; as-stated-summary-manner it holds for someone, from the application's coming in the to-be-told initiation; so initiation-and-rest is to be told.

tsa-a11-v02.quick_english: Therein: who is qualified? — for that determination the power-descent is examined.

tsa-a11-v03.quick_english: Therein some say: from absence of knowledge, saṃsāra rooted in ignorance; from its departure's knowledge-arising, power-descent. To them: knowledge-arising alone is distorted — to be said. If act-produced, [it behaves] like act-fruit; in enjoyment-ness, in the enjoymenter too — the two possibilities of power-descent are excessive consequence. In being-caused-by-the-Lord's-will, however: knowledge-arising's mutual-dependence and futility; in the Lord, passion-and-rest-issue. Of two contradictory acts of equal force, mutual-obstruction: act-equivalence — then power-descent? No: in being-sequential, from impossibility-of-contradiction; even in contradiction, of the uncontradicted act's enjoyment-giving issue — in non-contradicted act's non-occurrence, just-then body-death issue: birth-and-lifespan-giving act is not obstructed; enjoyment-giving is. If asked why: in that-act's-presence, if power might-fall, then she — of the enjoyment-giver — why would she fear?

tsa-a11-v04.quick_english: Now: in impurity-ripening, power-descent — of-what-nature, and its mark? By this the difference-doctrinaires' incoherent counter — dispassion, special-duty, discernment, true-service, true-attainment, god-worship and-rest-as-reason.

tsa-a11-v05.quick_english: In the doctrine-of-two-inseparables-of-free-Lord, however, it is sustained: as the Supreme-Lord by self-covering-sport attains cattle-being, individual, atom — no place-time-form-difference-contradiction of him; likewise, by withdrawal-of-self-hiding self-recovery — suddenly or in-order, taking-refuge, the atom is called vessel-of-power-descent. Made-merely-of-freedom this Supreme-Siva is power's causer-to-descend. Thus independent is the power-descent: who[se is] fruit-of-self-manifestation; but who[se] is one-eager-for-enjoyment, he is act-dependent; of one-eager-for-supernatural-enjoyment, he just is power-descent. Qualified-by-maya-womb-inspired-by-Lord's-will, through-door-of-Rudra-Vishnu-Brahma-and-rest, mantra-and-rest-form-ness, maya-puru-distinction, puru-kala, puru-nature, puru-intellect distinctions, and other fruit obtaining — lower-tattva-enjoyment binds. One-eager-for-both: in-enjoyment act-dependent; in-release independent-of-it — thus both-dependent-and-independent.

tsa-a11-v06.quick_english: Nor is it to-be-said: in-someone-just man power-descent. He just is the Supreme-Lord — thus shines. In-being-truth: who is this man, by-name — that in-purport object-made-impulse, this.

tsa-a11-v07.quick_english: And this power-descent ninefold in intense-middle-mild, by-superiority-equality-inferiority; again from-triplicity. Therein: from-superior-intense just-then in-body-death Supremeness; from-middle-intense, one-independent-of-scripture-teacher, of-own-conviction, intuitive-knowledge-arising — in-which-arising outer-consecration without-alone giving-enjoyment-and-release, intuitive teacher, thus said. For his no-conception-of-samayya-and-rest-any, even-herein degree-existence from-wills-manifoldness — thus, being-even in-intuitive-ness, dependence-on-scripture-and-rest would-be for-agreement — even. Thus many-fissures-and-walls-division of-teacher and of-intuitive-one in-scriptures is-said; in-any-case intuitive-part stronger in-its-presence, of-others from-unqualification.

tsa-a11-v08.quick_english: As difference-view, as in-presence-of-eternal-Siva of-liberated-Sivas in-creation-dissolution-and-rest-functions: from-mild-intense power-descent, good-guru-subject wish-to-be-attained becomes; in-bad-guru-subject, concealment just; from-bad-guru-ness, good-guru-approach from-power-descent indeed.

tsa-a11-v09.quick_english: Good-guru is full-of-all-this-scripture-truth-knowledge, directly Bhagavan-Bhairava-Bhattacharya — indeed of-yogis-even by-own-studied-knowledge in-freeness-giving; therein of-qualifiability like-good-fortune-beauty-and-rest-possession from-non-application.

tsa-a11-v11.quick_english: Thus-wisher's of-guru knowledge-named initiation obtains, by-which at-once freed becomes, living-even herein: from-seeing, from-telling, from-scripture-teaching, from-conduct-showing, from-charity-giving and-rest kinds.

tsa-a11-v12.quick_english: Of-practitioner or just-then at-once life-releasing initiation obtains; she but in-death-moment-alone to-be-done — thus we-shall-tell-thus.

tsa-a11-v13.quick_english: Intense threefold from-superior-middle power-descent: even-though-initiated, of-own-self in-Siva-ness not so firm-conviction becomes; by-ripening-order-of-conviction but at-body's-end Siva just. From-middle-intense but eager-for-Siva-ness even enjoyment-seeking becomes — thus just-so in-initiation vessel-of-knowledge, he and gained-by-yoga-practice by-this-alone by-body enjoyment-having at-body's-end Siva just.

tsa-a11-v14.quick_english: From-inferior-middle but by-another-body enjoyment-having Siva-hood attains — thus.

tsa-a11-v15.quick_english: Middle but threefold enjoyment-eagerness: when become-primary, then mildness by-Lord-mantra-yoga-means — since therein eagerness of-Lord-mantra-yoga-and-rest, since ending-in-release — therefore power-descent-nature.

tsa-a11-v16.quick_english: Even-therein from-degree triplicity — thus this chief power-descent.

tsa-a11-v17.quick_english: Of-Vaishnavas-and-rest but like-king's-grace not ending-in-release — thus no distinction herein.

tsa-a11-v18.quick_english: Siva-Power-abode but everywhere — said. She most-supreme is not, but fierce, fiercer or — this power-descent manifold even from-degree-manifoldness is-differentiated: some standing-in-Vaishnavas-and-rest by-samayya-and-rest-order in-five-streams attained-ripening supreme-authority-in-six-and-a-half-scriptures attains; other but by-transgression-order by-infinite-difference some non-sequential — thus. Therefore standing-in-lower-higher-doctrine teachers even herein in-mere-mandala-seeing even unqualified; standing-in-higher-doctrine but teacher lower-higher-doctrine on-the-contrary approves from-fullness — thus qualified-for-all.

tsa-a11-v19.quick_english: And-this guide, teacher, initiator, attractor — and-this full-knowledge just supreme; by-him without initiation-and-rest-attainment-failure.

tsa-a11-v20.quick_english: Yogi but of-one-eager-for-fruit joined: if by-means-teaching uninterrupted just fruit to-give able; by-means-teaching but in-knowledge just joined, in-release even in-proper-means desiring-knowledge-fullness, and many even teachers should-make.

tsa-a11-v21.quick_english: By-reference-to-supreme-and-rest-knowledge-differences in-them should-stay; in-abandoning-full-knowledge-guru but expiation just.

tsa-a11-v22.quick_english: But he even not-saying contrary or saying why not to-be-abandoned not-at-all — we-say: of-him indeed from-full-knowledge-ness indeed passion-and-rest-absence; thus non-saying-and-rest in-disciple-gone-itself by-someone from-unworthiness-untrustworthiness-and-rest as-cause would-be — thus; in-his-contemplation should-be-striven-for by-disciple not in-abandoning-him.

tsa-a11-v24.quick_english: Concealment — thus concealment indeed fruit-of-dependence-in-deep-sorrow-delusion: for-as from-light-freedom awakened even like-a-fool behaves; by-heart and foolish-behavior condemns; likewise fool even awakened-behavior mantra-worship-and-rest should-do, should-condemn — and as his foolish-behavior even-when-done of-awakened goes-to destruction. Likewise his awakened-behavior she but being-condemned from-being-forbidden-conduct-form oneself and by-it-alone from-self-suspicion him in-mire-of-sorrow-delusion he-drowns. Not but of-arisen-power-descent concealment-even exists herein even and dependence-on-act-and-rest as-before having-prohibited; therein even from-wills-manifoldness this body-only-enjoyment-sorrow-fruit-ness or in-initiation-covenant-conduct-teacher-god-fire-and-rest of-servicing-condemning-both-engaged like before of-Siva-doctrine-standers of-abandoning-him like.

tsa-a11-v25.quick_english: Even-therein from-wills-manifoldness concealed even oneself or by-power-descent is-joined, dead or through-mouth-of-kinsman-guru-etc-grace — thus in-this-way duty-share-ness in-own-self committing the-Supreme-Lord just — thus not maimed self should-see.

tsa-a11-v01.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v01.question: Why is initiation-and-rest announced here?
premises: As far as this has been stated — direct for someone's attainment-of-release; as-stated-summary-manner for someone, from the application's coming in the to-be-told initiation.
So initiation-and-rest is to be told.
tsa-a11-v01.inference: The prior statement serves release-directly for some and summary-manner for others; the to-be-told initiation's application triggers the new topic: dīkṣādikaṃ vaktavyam.

tsa-a11-v02.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v02.question: Who is qualified for śaktipāta?
premises: Therein: who is qualified? — for that determination the power-descent is examined.
tsa-a11-v02.inference: The adhikārī-question is the chapter's engine: śaktipāta itself is the criterion under examination.

tsa-a11-v03.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v03.question: What do the rival schools say, and what is the counter?
premises: Some say: from absence of knowledge, saṃsāra rooted in ignorance; from its departure's knowledge-arising, śaktipāta — to them knowledge-arising alone is distorted.
If act-produced, like act-fruit; in enjoyment and enjoymenter: excessive consequence. In Lord's-will-caused: mutual-dependence and futility; in the Lord, passion-issue.

Of equal contradictory acts, mutual-obstruction: act-equivalence — then śaktipāta? No: sequentiality forbids contradiction; uncontradicted act gives enjoyment but non-occurrence brings body-death; birth-and-lifespan act unobstructed, enjoyment-giving obstructed — if power fell on that, why would the enjoyer fear?
tsa-a11-v03.inference: Four rival accounts (jñāna-mūla, karma-produced, will-caused, equal-force) are dismantled: sequentiality blocks contradiction, and the enjoyment-giver's fear-argument closes the counter.

tsa-a11-v04.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v04.question: What marks śaktipāta in mala-ripening?
premises: Now in impurity-ripening, śaktipāta — of-what-nature and its mark?
By this the difference-doctrinaires' incoherent counter: dispassion, special-duty, discernment, true-service, true-attainment, god-worship and-rest-as-reason.
tsa-a11-v04.inference: The bheda-vādin's counter-catalogue (vairāgya-dharma-viveka-satsevā-satprāpti-devapūjā) is dismissed as asamañjasam by the mala-paripāke criterion.

tsa-a11-v05.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v05.question: How does the svatantra-parameśa-advaya doctrine sustain śaktipāta?
premises: By self-covering-sport the Lord attains paśu/pudgala/aṇu without place-time-form contradiction; by self-hiding-withdrawal self-recovery — suddenly or in-order — makes the atom a śaktipāta-pātra.
Made-merely-of-freedom, Śiva is power's causer: independent śaktipāta bears self-manifestation's fruit; the enjoyer's is act-dependent; the supernatural-enjoyer's is śaktipāta itself.
Māyā-womb-qualified, through Rudra-Viṣṇu-Brahmā doors, mantra-form-ness and the four vivekas bind lower-tattva-bhoga; one-eager-for-both: dependent in bhoga, independent in mokṣa — sāpekṣa-nirapekṣa.
tsa-a11-v05.inference: The advaya doctrine grounds the whole typology: independence of the śaktipāta, degrees of qualification through the deva-doors, and the double-bind of dual-eagerness.

tsa-a11-v06.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v06.question: Why is śaktipāta not said of some man?
premises: Nor is it to-be-said in-someone-just man śaktipāta: he just is the Supreme-Lord — thus shines.
In-being-truth: who is this man — that in-purport object-made impulse, this.
tsa-a11-v06.inference: The 'man' of śaktipāta collapses into parameśvara: pumān is codanā-viṣayakṛtā, a name-purport, not a substrate.

tsa-a11-v07.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v07.question: How is śaktipāta ninefold, and what is the prātibha-guru?
premises: Ninefold in intense-middle-mild by superiority-equality-inferiority; again triplicity.

From superior-intense: parameśatā at body-death; from middle-intense: prātibha-jñāna-udaya independent of śāstra-ācārya, giving bhoga-apavarga without outer saṃskāra — the intuitive guru, thus said (no samayyā-ādi-conception; degree from icchā-vaicitryāt).
Yet in prātibhatva śāstra-ādy-apekṣā would stand for saṃvāda; the teacher's many-fissured prātibha is uktam in scriptures; in any case intuitive-part is balīyān in its presence — others' anadhikārāt.
tsa-a11-v07.inference: The ninefold typology (utkarṣa/ādhyasthya/anikarṣa × tīvra/madhya/manda) and the prātibha-guru's paradox: self-authorized yet scripture-aligned, with the strongest-part rule.

tsa-a11-v08.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v08.question: How does difference-view relate to guru-seeking?
premises: As difference-view before eternal Śiva: from mild-intense śaktipāta, good-guru-subject wish arises; in bad-guru-subject, concealment only; from bad-guru-ness, good-guru-approach comes by śaktipāta itself.
tsa-a11-v08.inference: Tirobhāva vs yiyāsā: the same descent that conceals under a bad guru drives approach to a good one — bad-guru-lessness is śaktipāta-born.

tsa-a11-v09.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v09.question: Who is the sadguru?
premises: Good-guru is full of all this scripture-truth-knowledge — directly Bhagavad-bhairava-bhaṭṭāraka; even yogis free by own-studied-knowledge; therein yogyatva's saubhāgya-lāvaṇya-possession is anupayoga.
tsa-a11-v09.inference: The sadguru is pūrṇa-jñāna (Bhairava-bhaṭṭāraka directly), and qualification's fortune-beauty is irrelevant next to it (anupayoga).

tsa-a11-v10.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v10.question: Who is the asadguru?
premises: Bad-guru is other — all just.
tsa-a11-v10.inference: Sarva eva: every other is asadguru — the dichotomy is absolute.

tsa-a11-v11.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v11.question: What does the guru-seeker obtain?
premises: Thus the yiyāsuḥ obtains jñāna-lakṣaṇā dīkṣā — at-once freed even while living: the kinds are avalokana, kathana, śāstra-sambodhana, caryā-darśana, caru-dāna and rest.
tsa-a11-v11.inference: Jñāna-dīkṣā grants immediate mokṣa even jīvann; its five-ish modes (seeing/telling/teaching/showing/giving) are the bhedāḥ.

tsa-a11-v12.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v12.question: What does the abhyāsava get?
premises: Of-practitioner or just-then at-once prāṇa-viyojikā dīkṣā — she is to-be-done at the death-moment alone, it is said.
tsa-a11-v12.inference: For practitioners the life-releasing initiation comes at once but is executed only maraṇa-kṣaṇa — stated for later.

tsa-a11-v13.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v13.question: What are the three intense outcomes?
premises: From superior-middle śaktipāta: even-kṛta-dīkṣāka without firm pratipatti in own-śivatā — by ripening-order at dehānte, Śiva just; from middle-intense, eager-for-śivatā becomes bhoga-prepsu.
In dīkṣā, jñāna-bhājana gained by yoga-abhyāsa: with this body enjoying bhoga, at dehānte Śiva just.
tsa-a11-v13.inference: Tīvra grades: firm conviction delayed to dehānte or ripened; medium gets enjoyment-seeking; yoga-practice grants jñāna-vessel, body-bhoga ends in Śiva.

tsa-a11-v14.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v14.question: What of the nikṛṣṭa-madhyāt?
premises: From-inferior-middle but by-another-body enjoyment-having Siva-hood attains — thus.
tsa-a11-v14.inference: The lowest-middle: bhoga in another body (dehāntara), then śivatva — the graded ladder's bottom rung still lands.

tsa-a11-v15.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v15.question: What is madhya's threefold?
premises: Middle threefold by bhoga-utsukatā: when primary → manda-tva by pārameśvara-mantra-yoga-upāya (its eagerness, since mantra-yoga ends in mokṣa) — therefore śaktipāta-rūpatā.
tsa-a11-v15.inference: Madhya grades by desire-pronouncement: bhoga-primary = manda (cured by mantra-yoga), since that yoga's end is mokṣa itself — hence its śaktipāta-nature.

tsa-a11-v16.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v16.question: What is the chief śaktipāta?
premises: Even-therein from-degree triplicity — thus this mukhyaḥ śaktipāta.
tsa-a11-v16.inference: The chief is selected from the degree-triple — the mukhya designation rides tāratamya.

tsa-a11-v17.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v17.question: Does the Vaiṣṇava-stha have mokṣa-antatā?
premises: Of-Vaishnavas-and-rest but like-king's-grace not ending-in-release — thus no distinction herein.
tsa-a11-v17.inference: Vaiṣṇava-ādi-stha receives rājānugraha-like grace without mokṣāntatā — hence vivecana is inapplicable here.

tsa-a11-v18.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v18.question: How does śivaśaktyadhiṣṭhāna vary?
premises: Siva-Power-abode but everywhere — said; she most-supreme is not, but fierce/fiercer — śaktipāta manifold by tāratamya-vaicitrya.
Some Vaiṣṇava-ādi-stha by samayyādi-krama in srotaḥ-pañca prāpta-paripāka attains sarvottīrṇa-ṣaḍardha-śāstra-paramādhikāritā; others by ullāṅghana-krama ananta-bheda, some akramam — thus.
Hence adharādhara-śāsana-stha gurus even in mere-mandala-seeing are anadhikāriṇaḥ; ūrdhva-śāsana-stha approves adharādhara-śāsana on the contrary — pūrṇatvāt — sarvādhikārī.
tsa-a11-v18.inference: The central adhikāra-typology: six-and-a-half-scripture authority via samayyā-krama vs ullāṅghana-krama; lower-doctrine gurus unqualified even at mandala-seeing, higher gurus approve both — pūrṇatvāt sarvādhikārī.

tsa-a11-v19.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v19.question: Who teaches?
premises: And-this guide, teacher, initiator, attractor — and-this full-knowledge just supreme; by-him without initiation-and-rest-attainment-failure.
tsa-a11-v19.inference: The five-title teacher (daiśika-ācārya-dīkṣaka-cumbaka) is pūrṇa-jña-sarvottama; without him dīkṣādyasampatti fails.

tsa-a11-v20.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v20.question: What may the yogi do for others?
premises: Yogi of-eager-for-fruit joined: if by-upāya-upadeśa able to give uninterrupted fruit; in-knowledge joined gives mokṣa by abhyupāya; desiring-jñāna-pūrṇatā should-make many gurus.
tsa-a11-v20.inference: Phalotsuka-yogi gives fruit (even mokṣa) through means-teaching; jñāna-pūrṇatā-kāṅkṣī multiplies gurus.

tsa-a11-v21.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v21.question: What of knowledge-differences?
premises: By-reference-to-supreme-and-rest-knowledge-differences in-them should-stay; in-abandoning-pūrṇa-jñāna-guru but prāyaścittaṃ eva.
tsa-a11-v21.inference: Knowledge-graded adherence (uttamottamādi-bheda) vs abandoning the pūrṇa-jñāna-guru: only expiation stands.

tsa-a11-v22.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v22.question: Can the silent or wrong-speaking guru be abandoned?
premises: But he even abruvan viparītam vā bruvan — why not to-be-abandoned? Not-at-all: from pūrṇa-jñānatvāt rāga-ādy-bhāva-absence; avacanādikaṃ would be śiṣya-gata by some ayogyatvā-nāśvastatvāda-nimitta.
Hence in tad-upāsane yatanīyaṃ by śiṣya, not in tattyāga.
tsa-a11-v22.inference: Retorsion: even the silent/contrary guru is not abandoned (pūrṇa-jñāna entails rāga-absence); abandonment would be disciple-caused by unworthiness — strive in contemplation, not rejection.

tsa-a11-v23.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v23.question: What kind of śaktipāta is anugraha-nimitta?
premises: Thus caused-by-grace power-descent independent indeed from-dependence-on-act-and-rest-determinism.
tsa-a11-v23.inference: Anugraha-nimitta śaktipāta is nirapekṣa — grace breaks the karmādi-niyati dependence.

tsa-a11-v24.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v24.question: What is tirobhāva?
premises: Concealment indeed is fruit-of-dependence-in-deep-sorrow-delusion: like from-light-freedom awakened even behaves like-a-fool, condemns his own foolish-behavior by heart; likewise fool does awakened-behavior and condemns it — as his foolish-behavior even-done of-awakened goes to destruction.

His awakened-behavior, being-condemned, from niṣiddhācaraṇa-rūpatva and self-suspicion, drowns him in duḥkha-moha-paṅka; but of-arisen-śaktipātasya tirobhāvaḥ api asti — herein even karmādy-apekṣā as-before niṣedhyā.
From icchā-vaicitryāt: this dehātra-upabhoga-duḥkha-phalatvaṃ or in dīkṣā-samaya-caryā-guru-deva-agnyādau sevā-nindana-ubhaya-prasaktānām iva, before Śiva-śāsana-sthānām tattyāginām iva.
tsa-a11-v24.inference: Tirobhāva = karmādy-apekṣa's deep-sorrow-delusion fruit: the awakened-fool cycle drowns; even arisen-śaktipāta's concealment carries karmādy-apekṣā until icchā-vaicitryāt resolves it through sevā-nindana-twofold-engagement or doctrine-abandonment-analogues.

tsa-a11-v25.speaker: Teacher (śaktipāta-adhikāra)
tsa-a11-v25.question: How does tirobhūta still connect?
premises: Even-therein from-wills-manifoldness concealed even oneself or by-power-descent is-joined, dead or through-mouth-of-kinsman-guru-etc-grace — thus duty-share-ness in-own-self committing the-Supreme-Lord just — thus not maimed self should-see.
tsa-a11-v25.inference: Tirobhūta too is yujyate: svayaṃ or śaktipātena, mṛtaḥ or bandhu-guru-kṛpā-mukhena — kṛtya-bhāgitva committed to parameśvara eva; na khaṇḍitam ātmānaṃ paśyet.

tsa-a11-v01.plain_english: Thus, as far as this has been stated — direct for someone's attainment-of-release; as-stated-summary-manner it holds for someone, from the application's coming in the to-be-told initiation; so initiation-and-rest is to be told.
tsa-a11-v01.sanskrit_cite: tatra yāvat idam uktam tat sākṣāt kasyacit apavargāptaye yathoktasaṃgrahanītyā bhavati kasyacit vakṣyamāṇadīkṣāyām upayogagamanāt iti dīkṣādikaṃ vaktavyam

tsa-a11-v02.plain_english: Therein: who is qualified? — for that determination the power-descent is examined.
tsa-a11-v02.sanskrit_cite: tatra kaḥ adhikārī iti nirūpaṇārthaṃ śaktipāto vicāryate

tsa-a11-v03.plain_english: Therein some say: from absence of knowledge, saṃsāra rooted in ignorance; from its departure's knowledge-arising, power-descent. To them: knowledge-arising alone is distorted — to be said. If act-produced, [it behaves] like act-fruit; in enjoyment-ness, in the enjoymenter too — the two possibilities of power-descent are excessive consequence. In being-caused-by-the-Lord's-will, however: knowledge-arising's mutual-dependence and futility; in the Lord, passion-and-rest-issue. Of two contradictory acts of equal force, mutual-obstruction: act-equivalence — then power-descent? No: in being-sequential, from impossibility-of-contradiction; even in contradiction, of the uncontradicted act's enjoyment-giving issue — in non-contradicted act's non-occurrence, just-then body-death issue: birth-and-lifespan-giving act is not obstructed; enjoyment-giving is. If asked why: in that-act's-presence, if power might-fall, then she — of the enjoyment-giver — why would she fear?
tsa-a11-v03.sanskrit_cite: tatra kecit āhuḥ jñānābhāvāt ajñānamūlaḥ saṃsāraḥ tadapagame jñānodayāt śaktipāta iti teṣāṃ samyak jñānodaya eva vikṛta iti vācyam karmajanyatve karmaphalavat bhogatvaprasaṅge bhogini ca śaktipātābhyupagatau atiprasaṅgaḥ īśvarecchānimittatve tu jñānodayasya anyonyāśrayatā vaiyarthyaṃ ca īśvare rāgādiprasaṅgaḥ viruddhayoḥ karmaṇoḥ samabalayoḥ anyonyapratibandhe karmasāmyaṃ tataḥ śaktipāta iti cet na kramikatve virodhāyogāt virodhe 'pi anyasya aviruddhasya karmaṇo bhogadānaprasaṅgāt aviruddhakarmāpravṛttau tadaiva dehapātaprasaṅgāt jātyāyuṣpradaṃ karma na pratibadhyate bhogapradam eva tu pratibadhyate iti cet kutaḥ tatkarmasadbhāve yadi śaktiḥ patet tarhi sā bhogapradāt kiṃ bibhiyāt

tsa-a11-v04.plain_english: Now: in impurity-ripening, power-descent — of-what-nature, and its mark? By this the difference-doctrinaires' incoherent counter — dispassion, special-duty, discernment, true-service, true-attainment, god-worship and-rest-as-reason.
tsa-a11-v04.sanskrit_cite: atha malaparipāke śaktipātaḥ so 'pi kiṃsvarūpaḥ kiṃ ca tasya nimittam iti etena vairāgyaṃ dharmaviśeṣo vivekaḥ satsevā satprāptiḥ devapūjā ityādihetuḥ pratyukta iti bhedavādināṃ sarvam asamañjasam

tsa-a11-v05.plain_english: In the doctrine-of-two-inseparables-of-free-Lord, however, it is sustained: as the Supreme-Lord by self-covering-sport attains cattle-being, individual, atom — no place-time-form-difference-contradiction of him; likewise, by withdrawal-of-self-hiding self-recovery — suddenly or in-order, taking-refuge, the atom is called vessel-of-power-descent. Made-merely-of-freedom this Supreme-Siva is power's causer-to-descend. Thus independent is the power-descent: who[se is] fruit-of-self-manifestation; but who[se] is one-eager-for-enjoyment, he is act-dependent; of one-eager-for-supernatural-enjoyment, he just is power-descent. Qualified-by-maya-womb-inspired-by-Lord's-will, through-door-of-Rudra-Vishnu-Brahma-and-rest, mantra-and-rest-form-ness, maya-puru-distinction, puru-kala, puru-nature, puru-intellect distinctions, and other fruit obtaining — lower-tattva-enjoyment binds. One-eager-for-both: in-enjoyment act-dependent; in-release independent-of-it — thus both-dependent-and-independent.
tsa-a11-v05.sanskrit_cite: svatantraparameśādvayavāde tu upapadyate etat yathāhi parameśvaraḥ svarūpācchādanakrīḍayā paśuḥ pudgalo 'ṇuḥ sampannaḥ na ca tasya deśakālasvarūpabhedavirodhaḥ tadvat svarūpasthaganavinivṛttyā svarūpapratyāpattiṃ jhaṭiti vā krameṇa vā samāśrayan śaktipātapātram aṇuḥ ucyate svātantryamātrasāraś ca asau paramaśivaḥ śakteḥ pātayitā iti nirapekṣa eva śaktipāto yaḥ svarūpaprathāphalaḥ yas tu bhogotsukasya sa karmāpekṣaḥ lokottararūpabhogotsukasya tu sa eva śaktipātaḥ parameśvarecchāpreritamāyāgarbhādhikārīyarudraviṣṇubrahmādidvāreṇa mantrādirūpatvaṃ māyāpuṃvivekaṃ puṃskalāvivekaṃ puṃprakṛtivivekaṃ puṃbuddhivivekam anyac ca phalaṃ prasnuvānaḥ tadadharatattvabhogaṃ pratibadhnāti bhogamokṣobhayotsukasya bhoge karmāpekṣo mokṣe tu tannirapekṣaḥ iti sāpekṣanirapekṣaḥ

tsa-a11-v06.plain_english: Nor is it to-be-said: in-someone-just man power-descent. He just is the Supreme-Lord — thus shines. In-being-truth: who is this man, by-name — that in-purport object-made-impulse, this.
tsa-a11-v06.sanskrit_cite: na ca vācyaṃ kasmāt kasmiṃścid eva puṃsi śaktipāta iti sa eva parameśvaraḥ tathā bhāti iti satattve ko 'sau pumān nāma yaduddeśena viṣayakṛtā codanā iyam

tsa-a11-v07.plain_english: And this power-descent ninefold in intense-middle-mild, by-superiority-equality-inferiority; again from-triplicity. Therein: from-superior-intense just-then in-body-death Supremeness; from-middle-intense, one-independent-of-scripture-teacher, of-own-conviction, intuitive-knowledge-arising — in-which-arising outer-consecration without-alone giving-enjoyment-and-release, intuitive teacher, thus said. For his no-conception-of-samayya-and-rest-any, even-herein degree-existence from-wills-manifoldness — thus, being-even in-intuitive-ness, dependence-on-scripture-and-rest would-be for-agreement — even. Thus many-fissures-and-walls-division of-teacher and of-intuitive-one in-scriptures is-said; in-any-case intuitive-part stronger in-its-presence, of-others from-unqualification.
tsa-a11-v07.sanskrit_cite: sa cāyaṃ śaktipāto navadhā tīvramadhyamandasya utkarṣamādhyasthyanikarṣaiḥ punas traividhyāt tatra utkṛṣṭatīvrāt tadaiva dehapāte parameśatā madhyatīvrāt śāstrācāryānapekṣiṇaḥ svapratyayasya prātibhajñānodayaḥ yadudaye bāhyasaṃskāraṃ vinaiva bhogāpavargapradaḥ prātibho gurur ity ucyate tasya hi na samayyādikalpanā kācit atrāpi tāratamyasadbhāvaḥ icchāvaicitryāt iti saty api prātibhatve śāstrādyapekṣā saṃvādāya syād api iti nirbhittisabhittyādibahubhedatvam ācāryasya prātibhasyāgameṣu uktam sarvathā pratibhāṃśo balīyān tatsaṃnidhau anyeṣām anadhikārāt

tsa-a11-v08.plain_english: As difference-view, as in-presence-of-eternal-Siva of-liberated-Sivas in-creation-dissolution-and-rest-functions: from-mild-intense power-descent, good-guru-subject wish-to-be-attained becomes; in-bad-guru-subject, concealment just; from-bad-guru-ness, good-guru-approach from-power-descent indeed.
tsa-a11-v08.sanskrit_cite: bhedadarśana iva anādiśivasaṃnidhau muktaśivānāṃ sṛṣṭilayādikṛtyeṣu mandatīvrāt śaktipātāt sadguruviṣayā yiyāsā bhavati asadguruviṣayāyāṃ tu tirobhāva eva asadgurutas tu sadgurugamanaṃ śaktipātād eva

tsa-a11-v09.plain_english: Good-guru is full-of-all-this-scripture-truth-knowledge, directly Bhagavan-Bhairava-Bhattacharya — indeed of-yogis-even by-own-studied-knowledge in-freeness-giving; therein of-qualifiability like-good-fortune-beauty-and-rest-possession from-non-application.
tsa-a11-v09.sanskrit_cite: sadgurus tu samastaitacchāstratattvajñānapūrṇaḥ sākṣāt bhagavadbhairavabhaṭṭāraka eva yogino 'pi svabhyastajñānatayaiva mocakatve tatra yogyatvasya saubhāgyalāvaṇyādimattvasyevānupayogāt

tsa-a11-v11.plain_english: Thus-wisher's of-guru knowledge-named initiation obtains, by-which at-once freed becomes, living-even herein: from-seeing, from-telling, from-scripture-teaching, from-conduct-showing, from-charity-giving and-rest kinds.
tsa-a11-v11.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yiyāsuḥ guroḥ jñānalakṣaṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāpnoti yayā sadya eva mukto bhavati jīvann api atra avalokanāt kathanāt śāstrasambodhanāt caryādarśanāt carudānāt ityādayo bhedāḥ

tsa-a11-v12.plain_english: Of-practitioner or just-then at-once life-releasing initiation obtains; she but in-death-moment-alone to-be-done — thus we-shall-tell-thus.
tsa-a11-v12.sanskrit_cite: abhyāsavato vā tadānīṃ sadya eva prāṇaviyojikāṃ dīkṣāṃ labhate sā tu maraṇakṣaṇa eva kāryā iti vakṣyāma iti

tsa-a11-v13.plain_english: Intense threefold from-superior-middle power-descent: even-though-initiated, of-own-self in-Siva-ness not so firm-conviction becomes; by-ripening-order-of-conviction but at-body's-end Siva just. From-middle-intense but eager-for-Siva-ness even enjoyment-seeking becomes — thus just-so in-initiation vessel-of-knowledge, he and gained-by-yoga-practice by-this-alone by-body enjoyment-having at-body's-end Siva just.
tsa-a11-v13.sanskrit_cite: tīvrās tridhā utkṛṣṭamadhyāt śaktipātāt kṛtadīkṣāko 'pi svātmanaḥ śivatāyāṃ na tathā dṛḍhapratipattiḥ bhavati pratipattiparipākakrameṇa tu dehānte śiva eva madhyamadhyāt tu śivatotsuko 'pi bhogaprepsuḥ bhavati iti tathaiva dīkṣāyāṃ jñānabhājanam sa ca yogābhyāsalabdham anenaiva dehena bhogaṃ bhuktvā dehānte śiva eva

tsa-a11-v14.plain_english: From-inferior-middle but by-another-body enjoyment-having Siva-hood attains — thus.
tsa-a11-v14.sanskrit_cite: nikṛṣṭamadhyāt tu dehāntareṇa bhogaṃ bhuktvā śivatvam eti iti

tsa-a11-v15.plain_english: Middle but threefold enjoyment-eagerness: when become-primary, then mildness by-Lord-mantra-yoga-means — since therein eagerness of-Lord-mantra-yoga-and-rest, since ending-in-release — therefore power-descent-nature.
tsa-a11-v15.sanskrit_cite: madhyas tu tridhā bhogotsukatā yadā pradhānabhūtā tadā mandatvaṃ pārameśvaramantrayogopāyatayā yatas tatra autsukyam pārameśamantrayogādeś ca yato mokṣaparyantatvam ataḥ śaktipātarūpatā

tsa-a11-v16.plain_english: Even-therein from-degree triplicity — thus this chief power-descent.
tsa-a11-v16.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi tāratamyāt traividhyam ity eṣa mukhyaḥ śaktipātaḥ

tsa-a11-v17.plain_english: Of-Vaishnavas-and-rest but like-king's-grace not ending-in-release — thus no distinction herein.
tsa-a11-v17.sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ tu rājānugrahavat na mokṣāntatā iti na iha vivecanam

tsa-a11-v18.plain_english: Siva-Power-abode but everywhere — said. She most-supreme is not, but fierce, fiercer or — this power-descent manifold even from-degree-manifoldness is-differentiated: some standing-in-Vaishnavas-and-rest by-samayya-and-rest-order in-five-streams attained-ripening supreme-authority-in-six-and-a-half-scriptures attains; other but by-transgression-order by-infinite-difference some non-sequential — thus. Therefore standing-in-lower-higher-doctrine teachers even herein in-mere-mandala-seeing even unqualified; standing-in-higher-doctrine but teacher lower-higher-doctrine on-the-contrary approves from-fullness — thus qualified-for-all.
tsa-a11-v18.sanskrit_cite: śivaśaktyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu sarvatra iti uktam sā paraṃ jyeṣṭhā na bhavati api tu ghorā ghoratarā vā sa eṣa śaktipāto vicitro 'pi tāratamyavaicitryāt bhidyate kaścid vaiṣṇavādisthaḥ samayyādikrameṇa srotaḥpañcake ca prāptaparipākaḥ sarvottīrṇabhagavatṣaḍardhaśāstraparamādhikāritām eti anyas tu ullaṅghanakrameṇa anantabhedena ko 'pi akramam iti ata eva adharādharaśāsanasthā guravo 'pi iha maṇḍalamātradarśane 'pi anadhikāriṇaḥ ūrdhvaśāsanasthas tu guruḥ adharādharaśāsanaṃ pratyuta prāṇayati pūrṇatvāt iti sarvādhikārī

tsa-a11-v19.plain_english: And-this guide, teacher, initiator, attractor — and-this full-knowledge just supreme; by-him without initiation-and-rest-attainment-failure.
tsa-a11-v19.sanskrit_cite: sa ca daiśiko guruḥ ācāryo dīkṣakaḥ cumbakaḥ sa cāyaṃ pūrṇajñāna eva sarvottamaḥ tena vinā dīkṣādyasampatteḥ

tsa-a11-v20.plain_english: Yogi but of-one-eager-for-fruit joined: if by-means-teaching uninterrupted just fruit to-give able; by-means-teaching but in-knowledge just joined, in-release even in-proper-means desiring-knowledge-fullness, and many even teachers should-make.
tsa-a11-v20.sanskrit_cite: yogī tu phalotsukasya yukto yadi upāyopadeśena avyavahitam eva phalaṃ dātuṃ śaktaḥ upāyopadeśena tu jñāne eva yukto mokṣe 'pi abhyupāyāt jñānapūrṇatākāṅkṣī ca bahūn api gurūn kuryāt

tsa-a11-v21.plain_english: By-reference-to-supreme-and-rest-knowledge-differences in-them should-stay; in-abandoning-full-knowledge-guru but expiation just.
tsa-a11-v21.sanskrit_cite: uttamottamādijñānabhedāpekṣayā teṣu varteta sampūrṇajñānagurutyāge tu prāyaścittam eva

tsa-a11-v22.plain_english: But he even not-saying contrary or saying why not to-be-abandoned not-at-all — we-say: of-him indeed from-full-knowledge-ness indeed passion-and-rest-absence; thus non-saying-and-rest in-disciple-gone-itself by-someone from-unworthiness-untrustworthiness-and-rest as-cause would-be — thus; in-his-contemplation should-be-striven-for by-disciple not in-abandoning-him.
tsa-a11-v22.sanskrit_cite: nanu so 'pi abruvan viparītaṃ vā bruvan kiṃ na tyājyaḥ naiva iti brūmaḥ tasya hi pūrṇajñānatvāt eva rāgādyabhāva iti avacanādikaṃ śiṣyagatenaiva kenacit ayogyatvānāśvastatvādinā nimittena syāt iti tadupāsane yatanīyaṃ śiṣyeṇa na tattyāge

tsa-a11-v23.sanskrit_cite: evam anugrahanimittaṃ śaktipāto nirapekṣa eva karmādiniyatyapekṣaṇāt

tsa-a11-v24.plain_english: Concealment — thus concealment indeed fruit-of-dependence-in-deep-sorrow-delusion: for-as from-light-freedom awakened even like-a-fool behaves; by-heart and foolish-behavior condemns; likewise fool even awakened-behavior mantra-worship-and-rest should-do, should-condemn — and as his foolish-behavior even-when-done of-awakened goes-to destruction. Likewise his awakened-behavior she but being-condemned from-being-forbidden-conduct-form oneself and by-it-alone from-self-suspicion him in-mire-of-sorrow-delusion he-drowns. Not but of-arisen-power-descent concealment-even exists herein even and dependence-on-act-and-rest as-before having-prohibited; therein even from-wills-manifoldness this body-only-enjoyment-sorrow-fruit-ness or in-initiation-covenant-conduct-teacher-god-fire-and-rest of-servicing-condemning-both-engaged like before of-Siva-doctrine-standers of-abandoning-him like.
tsa-a11-v24.sanskrit_cite: tirobhāva iti tirobhāvo hi karmādyapekṣagāḍhaduḥkhamohabhāgitvaphalaḥ yathāhi prakāśasvātantryāt prabuddho 'pi mūḍhavat ceṣṭate hṛdayena ca mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ nindati tathā mūḍho 'pi prabuddhaceṣṭāṃ mantrārādhanādikāṃ kuryāt nindec ca yathā ca asya mūḍhaceṣṭā kriyamāṇāpi prabuddhasya dhvaṃsam eti tathā asya prabuddhaceṣṭā sā tu nindyamānā niṣiddhācaraṇarūpatvāt svayaṃ ca tayaiva viśaṅkamānatvāt enaṃ duḥkhamohapaṅke nimajjayati na tu utpannaśaktipātasya tirobhāvo 'sti atrāpi ca karmādyapekṣā pūrvavat niṣedhyā tatrāpi ca icchāvaicitryāt etad dehamātropabhogyaduḥkhaphalatvaṃ vā dīkṣāsamayacaryāgurudevāgnyādau sevānindanobhayaprasaktānām iva prāk śivaśāsanasthānāṃ tattyāginām iva

tsa-a11-v25.plain_english: Even-therein from-wills-manifoldness concealed even oneself or by-power-descent is-joined, dead or through-mouth-of-kinsman-guru-etc-grace — thus in-this-way duty-share-ness in-own-self committing the-Supreme-Lord just — thus not maimed self should-see.
tsa-a11-v25.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi icchāvaicitryāt tirobhūto 'pi svayaṃ vā śaktipātena yujyate mṛto vā bandhugurvādikṛpāmukhena ity evaṃ kṛtyabhāgitvaṃ svātmani anusaṃdadhat parameśvara eva iti na khaṇḍitam ātmānaṃ paśyet

essence: Prior statement serves release directly or as summary; hence initiation-and-rest is to be told.
The adhikārī-question: śaktipāta itself is examined as the criterion.
Four rival accounts of śaktipāta dismantled — sequentiality blocks contradiction; the enjoyment-giver's fear-argument closes.
In mala-ripening, śaktipāta's nature-and-mark: the bheda-vādin's counter-catalogue is asamañjasam.
The advaya doctrine grounds the typology: independence of the descent, deva-door qualification, dual-eagerness's double-bind.
Śaktipāta is not of some man: he just is the Supreme-Lord — pumān is purport-impulse, not substrate.
Ninefold by degree; the prātibha-guru — self-authorized yet scripture-aligned, intuitive-part balīyān in its presence.
Difference-view drives guru-seeking: bad-guru concealment, good-guru-approach born of the same descent.
The sadguru: pūrṇa-jñāna directly, Bhairava-bhaṭṭāraka — qualification's fortune-beauty is anupayoga.
The asadguru: every other — all just.
Jñāna-dīkṣā: at-once freed even living — seeing, telling, teaching, showing, giving, the kinds.
The practitioner's prāṇa-viyojikā: at-once, executed at the death-moment alone.
Three intense grades: firm conviction ripened to dehānte; middle eager for bhoga; yoga-practice grants the jñāna-vessel.
The lowest-middle: enjoyment in another body, then śivatva.
Middle graded by desire-pronouncement: bhoga-primary = manda, cured by mantra-yoga ending in mokṣa — hence its śaktipāta-nature.
The chief: from the degree-triple — mukhya designation rides tāratamya.
Vaiṣṇava-ādi-stha: king's-grace-like, no mokṣa-antatā — no vivecana here.

Siva-Power-abode everywhere, not most-supreme but fierce-manifold: samayyā-krama attains six-and-a-half-scripture authority; ullāṅghana-krama infinite-difference, some akramam — lower-gurus unmandala-qualified, higher approve both: pūrṇatvāt sarvādhikārī.
The five-title teacher, pūrṇa-jña-sarvottama: without him dīkṣādyasampatti fails.
The fruit-eager yogi gives fruit by upāya-upadeśa; jñāna-pūrṇatā-kāṅkṣī multiplies gurus.
Knowledge-graded adherence; abandoning the pūrṇa-jñāna-guru: expiation alone.
The silent or wrong-speaking guru is not abandoned — pūrṇa-jñāna entails rāga-absence; strive in contemplation, not rejection.
Anugraha-nimitta: grace-born descent, independent of karmādi-niyati.
Tirobhāva: dependence's sorrow-delusion fruit — the awakened-fool cycle drowns; even arisen-descent's concealment carries karmādy-apekṣā until will-manifoldness resolves it.
Tirobhūta too is joined — svayaṃ or śaktipātena, dead or grace-mouthed: duty-share committed to the Supreme-Lord; the self seen unmaimed.

rasa.dominant: vīra-adbhuta of criteria established (exultation at the typology landing)
rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha-vismaya (exultation in classification, wonder at grace-independent descent)

Jñāna-dīkṣā: at-once freed even living — seeing, telling, teaching, showing, giving, the kinds. The practitioner's prāṇa-viyojikā: at-once, executed at the death-moment alone. Three intense grades: firm conviction ripened to dehānte; middle eager for bhoga; yoga-practice grants the jñāna-vessel. The lowest-middle: enjoyment in another body, then śivatva. Middle graded by desire-pronouncement: bhoga-primary = manda, cured by mantra-yoga ending in mokṣa — hence its śaktipāta-nature. The chief: from the degree-triple — mukhya designation rides tāratamya. Vaiṣṇava-ādi-stha: king's-grace-like, no mokṣa-antatā — no vivecana here. Siva-Power-abode everywhere, not most-supreme but fierce-manifold: samayyā-krama attains six-and-a-half-scripture authority; ullāṅghana-krama infinite-difference, some akramam — lower-gurus unmandala-qualified, higher approve both: pūrṇatvāt sarvādhikārī. The five-title teacher, pūrṇa-jña-sarvottama: without him dīkṣādyasampatti fails. The fruit-eager yogi gives fruit by upāya-upadeśa; jñāna-pūrṇatā-kāṅkṣī multiplies gurus. Knowledge-graded adherence; abandoning the pūrṇa-jñāna-guru: expiation alone. The silent or wrong-speaking guru is not abandoned — pūrṇa-jñāna entails rāga-absence; strive in contemplation, not rejection. Anugraha-nimitta: grace-born descent, independent of karmādi-niyati. Tirobhāva: dependence's sorrow-delusion fruit — the awakened-fool cycle drowns; even arisen-descent's concealment carries karmādy-apekṣā until will-manifoldness resolves it. Tirobhūta too is joined — svayaṃ or śaktipātena, dead or grace-mouthed: duty-share committed to the Supreme-Lord; the self seen unmaimed.
sections.FUNCTION: Examines who is qualified for śaktipāta: dismantles rival accounts, sets the advaya doctrine, types the descent ninefold (then by grade and desire), defines sadguru/asadguru and the prātibha-guru, and closes with tirobhāva's structure and the unmaimed-self verdict.
sections.KEY TERMS: śaktipāta (the descent as criterion); adhikārī (qualification question); prātibha-jñāna (intuitive knowledge-guru); sāpekṣa-nirapekṣa (dependent-independent double-bind); tirobhāva (concealment as karmādy-fruit); ullāṅghana-krama (transgression-path to authority); anugraha-nimitta (grace-born descent).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Follows the dīkṣādika-announcement (u1); the adhikāra-typology (u18) is the chapter's center; feeds the death-rites logic of a17-a19 already gold.
sections.BOUNDARY: Rival schools dismantled but quoted fairly; prātibha-guru's scripture-dependence held both ways (self-authorized AND saṃvāda-seeking); tirobhāva's severity stated without pastoral softening.
sections.EXPLANATION: Because śaktipāta is the criterion, the rival explanations (knowledge-absence, act-product, will-cause, equal-force) each fail on sequence or enjoyment-logic. The advaya doctrine then types the descent by freedom (independent for self-manifestation, dependent for enjoyment, śaktipāta itself for the supernatural-eager), and grades by intensity and desire-pronouncement. The guru-typology follows: sadguru as pūrṇa-jñāna, every other as asadguru, the prātibha-guru self-authorized yet scripture-aligned. Tirobhāva is the fruit of karmādy-apekṣa — a cycle only will-manifoldness or grace-born descent breaks — and even then, the self must not be seen maimed.
sections.RELATED: Tantrasāloka adhikāra chapters (lore support); Śivopaniṣad/Vijñānabhairava parallels on prātibha (future); qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.

lines: Some there say: knowledge absent, ignorance roots saṃsāra; from its going, knowledge-rise — that is descent. To their claim: knowledge-alone is the distortion.

Will-caused, the knowledge-rise leans on itself in vain; in the Lord, passion's issue follows.
Equal contradictory acts block each other — act-parity, they say, then descent? Not so: sequence forbids clash; where acts do not clash, enjoyment issues, but non-occurrence brings body-death.
Birth-and-lifespan giving stays unobstructed; only enjoyment-giving is bound — and if power fell on that, what fear would the enjoyer have?

Made of freedom alone, this Supreme-Śiva is the causer of power's fall: independent, bearing self-manifestation as fruit.
But the enjoyment-eager one's is act-tied; the supernatural-eager's — that very one is descent.
Māyā-womb-qualified through Rudra-Viṣṇu-Brahmā's door, mantra-form-ness, the four vivekas, and other fruits — these bind lower-tattva-bhoga.
Both-eager: tied in enjoyment, free in release — tied and untied at once.

By withdrawal of self-hiding, self-recovery — sudden or staged, taking refuge — makes the atom a vessel for descent.
Made of freedom alone, this Supreme-Śiva is the causer of power's fall: independent, bearing self-manifestation as fruit.
But the enjoyment-eager one's is act-tied; the supernatural-eager's — that very one is descent.
Māyā-womb-qualified through Rudra-Viṣṇu-Brahmā's door, mantra-form-ness, the four vivekas, and other fruits — these bind lower-tattva-bhoga.
Both-eager: tied in enjoyment, free in release — tied and untied at once.
tsa-a11-v05.sanskrit_cite: svatantraparameśādvayavāde tu upapadyate etat yathāhi parameśvaraḥ svarūpācchādanakrīḍayā paśuḥ pudgalo 'ṇuḥ sampannaḥ na ca tasya deśakālasvarūpabhedavirodhaḥ tadvat svarūpasthaganavinivṛttyā svarūpapratyāpattiṃ jhaṭiti vā krameṇa vā samāśrayan śaktipātapātram aṇuḥ ucyate svātantryamātrasāraś ca asau paramaśivaḥ śakteḥ pātayitā iti nirapekṣa eva śaktipāto yaḥ svarūpaprathāphalaḥ yas tu bhogotsukasya sa karmāpekṣaḥ lokottararūpabhogotsukasya tu sa eva śaktipātaḥ parameśvarecchāpreritamāyāgarbhādhikārīyarudraviṣṇubrahmādidvāreṇa mantrādirūpatvaṃ māyāpuṃvivekaṃ puṃskalāvivekaṃ puṃprakṛtivivekaṃ puṃbuddhivivekam anyac ca phalaṃ prasnuvānaḥ tadadharatattvabhogaṃ pratibadhnāti bhogamokṣobhayotsukasya bhoge karmāpekṣo mokṣe tu tannirapekṣaḥ iti sāpekṣanirapekṣaḥ

lines: Nor is it to-be-said in-someone-just man descent:
he just is the Supreme-Lord — thus shines.
In-being-truth: who is this man, by-name —
that in-purport object-made impulse, this.
tsa-a11-v06.sanskrit_cite: na ca vācyaṃ kasmāt kasmiṃścid eva puṃsi śaktipāta iti sa eva parameśvaraḥ tathā bhāti iti satattve ko 'sau pumān nāma yaduddeśena viṣayakṛtā codanā iyam

lines: And this power-descent ninefold in intense-middle-mild,
by-superiority-equality-inferiority; again triplicity.
From superior-intense: Supremeness just-then in-body-death;
from middle-intense, one-independent-of-scripture-teacher,
of-own-conviction, intuitive-knowledge-arising —
in-which-arising outer-consecration without-alone
giving-enjoyment-and-release, intuitive teacher, thus said.
For his no-conception-of-samayya-and-rest-any,
even-herein degree-existence from-wills-manifoldness —
thus, being-even in-intuitive-ness, dependence
on-scripture-and-rest would-be for-agreement — even.
So the teacher's many fissures and walls, in scripts, is told;
and of-intuitive-one in-scriptures is-said;
in any case, the intuitive part stands stronger in its presence — others, from unqualification.
of-others from-unqualification.
tsa-a11-v07.sanskrit_cite: sa cāyaṃ śaktipāto navadhā tīvramadhyamandasya utkarṣamādhyasthyanikarṣaiḥ punas traividhyāt tatra utkṛṣṭatīvrāt tadaiva dehapāte parameśatā madhyatīvrāt śāstrācāryānapekṣiṇaḥ svapratyayasya prātibhajñānodayaḥ yadudaye bāhyasaṃskāraṃ vinaiva bhogāpavargapradaḥ prātibho gurur ity ucyate tasya hi na samayyādikalpanā kācit atrāpi tāratamyasadbhāvaḥ icchāvaicitryāt iti saty api prātibhatve śāstrādyapekṣā saṃvādāya syād api iti nirbhittisabhittyādibahubhedatvam ācāryasya prātibhasyāgameṣu uktam sarvathā pratibhāṃśo balīyān tatsaṃnidhau anyeṣām anadhikārāt

lines: Like difference-view before eternal Śiva, among liberated-Śivas at creation-dissolution-work: from mild-intense descent, longing for a good guru arises; in a bad guru, only concealment; from bad-guru-ness, the good-guru-way comes by descent itself.
tsa-a11-v08.sanskrit_cite: bhedadarśana iva anādiśivasaṃnidhau muktaśivānāṃ sṛṣṭilayādikṛtyeṣu mandatīvrāt śaktipātāt sadguruviṣayā yiyāsā bhavati asadguruviṣayāyāṃ tu tirobhāva eva asadgurutas tu sadgurugamanaṃ śaktipātād eva

lines: Good-guru is full-of-all-this-scripture-truth-knowledge,
directly Bhagavan-Bhairava-Bhattacharya — indeed
of-yogis-even by-own-studied-knowledge in-freeness-giving;
therein of-qualifiability like-good-fortune-beauty-possession
from-non-application.
tsa-a11-v09.sanskrit_cite: sadgurus tu samastaitacchāstratattvajñānapūrṇaḥ sākṣāt bhagavadbhairavabhaṭṭāraka eva yogino 'pi svabhyastajñānatayaiva mocakatve tatra yogyatvasya saubhāgyalāvaṇyādimattvasyevānupayogāt

lines: The bad guru: every other —
all just.
The longing one thereby gains the guru's knowledge-initiation — by it at once freed, even living here.
Its kinds: seeing, telling, scripture-teaching, conduct-showing, charity-giving, and the rest.
tsa-a11-v11.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yiyāsuḥ guroḥ jñānalakṣaṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāpnoti yayā sadya eva mukto bhavati jīvann api atra avalokanāt kathanāt śāstrasambodhanāt caryādarśanāt carudānāt ityādayo bhedāḥ

lines: For the practitioner, or just then, at once the life-releasing initiation is gained; but she is to be done at death's moment alone — so it is told.
tsa-a11-v12.sanskrit_cite: abhyāsavato vā tadānīṃ sadya eva prāṇaviyojikāṃ dīkṣāṃ labhate sā tu maraṇakṣaṇa eva kāryā iti vakṣyāma iti

lines: Intense threefold from superior-middle descent: even the initiated gets no firm conviction in own-Śiva-ness — by ripening-order only, at body's-end, Śiva just.
From middle-intense, eager-for-Śiva becomes enjoyment-seeker; in initiation, knowledge-vessel — gained by yoga-practice, with this very body enjoying, at body's-end Śiva just.
tsa-a11-v13.sanskrit_cite: tīvrās tridhā utkṛṣṭamadhyāt śaktipātāt kṛtadīkṣāko 'pi svātmanaḥ śivatāyāṃ na tathā dṛḍhapratipattiḥ bhavati pratipattiparipākakrameṇa tu dehānte śiva eva madhyamadhyāt tu śivatotsuko 'pi bhogaprepsuḥ bhavati iti tathaiva dīkṣāyāṃ jñānabhājanam sa ca yogābhyāsalabdham anenaiva dehena bhogaṃ bhuktvā dehānte śiva eva

lines: From the inferior-middle, through another body, enjoying, he reaches Śiva-hood — so.
tsa-a11-v14.sanskrit_cite: nikṛṣṭamadhyāt tu dehāntareṇa bhogaṃ bhuktvā śivatvam eti iti

lines: Middle too is threefold by desire-pronouncement: when desire leads, mildness — by Lord-mantra-yoga means, since desire there, since that yoga's end is release — hence its descent-nature.
tsa-a11-v15.sanskrit_cite: madhyas tu tridhā bhogotsukatā yadā pradhānabhūtā tadā mandatvaṃ pārameśvaramantrayogopāyatayā yatas tatra autsukyam pārameśamantrayogādeś ca yato mokṣaparyantatvam ataḥ śaktipātarūpatā

lines: Even within, by degree's triplicity — such the chief descent.
tsa-a11-v16.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi tāratamyāt traividhyam ity eṣa mukhyaḥ śaktipātaḥ

lines: For Vaiṣṇavas-and-rest, like a king's grace — no release-ending: so no weighing here.
tsa-a11-v17.sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ tu rājānugrahavat na mokṣāntatā iti na iha vivecanam

lines: The Śiva-Power-abode, though, is everywhere — so said.
She is not most-supreme, but fierce, or fiercer: manifold the descent, split by manifold degrees.
Some Vaiṣṇava-standing, by samayyā-order, in the five streams, ripened — attains the six-and-a-half-scriptures' supreme authority;
others by leap-order, by infinite difference — some unsequential — so.

Hence lower-and-higher-doctrine-standing teachers, even at mere-mandala-seeing, are unqualified; the higher-standing teacher, by contrast, approves lower-and-higher-doctrine, from fullness — thus qualified-for-all.
tsa-a11-v18.sanskrit_cite: śivaśaktyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu sarvatra iti uktam sā paraṃ jyeṣṭhā na bhavati api tu ghorā ghoratarā vā sa eṣa śaktipāto vicitro 'pi tāratamyavaicitryāt bhidyate kaścid vaiṣṇavādisthaḥ samayyādikrameṇa srotaḥpañcake ca prāptaparipākaḥ sarvottīrṇabhagavatṣaḍardhaśāstraparamādhikāritām eti anyas tu ullaṅghanakrameṇa anantabhedena ko 'pi akramam iti ata eva adharādharaśāsanasthā guravo 'pi iha maṇḍalamātradarśane 'pi anadhikāriṇaḥ ūrdhvaśāsanasthas tu guruḥ adharādharaśāsanaṃ pratyuta prāṇayati pūrṇatvāt iti sarvādhikārī

lines: Here the guide, teacher, initiator, attractor — full-knowledge, just supreme: by him, initiation-and-rest cannot fail.
tsa-a11-v19.sanskrit_cite: sa ca daiśiko guruḥ ācāryo dīkṣakaḥ cumbakaḥ sa cāyaṃ pūrṇajñāna eva sarvottamaḥ tena vinā dīkṣādyasampatteḥ

lines: The yogi joined to fruit-eagerness: by means-teaching, able to give uninterrupted fruit; joined in knowledge gives release by proper means; desiring knowledge-fullness, many gurus he should make.
tsa-a11-v20.sanskrit_cite: yogī tu phalotsukasya yukto yadi upāyopadeśena avyavahitam eva phalaṃ dātuṃ śaktaḥ upāyopadeśena tu jñāne eva yukto mokṣe 'pi abhyupāyāt jñānapūrṇatākāṅkṣī ca bahūn api gurūn kuryāt

lines: By knowledge-grades supreme-and-rest, in them he stays; abandoning the full-knowledge-guru, only expiation stands.
tsa-a11-v21.sanskrit_cite: uttamottamādijñānabhedāpekṣayā teṣu varteta sampūrṇajñānagurutyāge tu prāyaścittam eva

lines: But he — silent, or speaking wrongly — why not abandon him? Never: from full-knowledge-ness, passion's absence is his.
Non-speech-and-rest would come from the disciple's side, by some unworthiness-untrustworthiness cause — so.
Hence in contemplation of him the disciple strives, not in his abandonment.
tsa-a11-v22.sanskrit_cite: nanu so 'pi abruvan viparītaṃ vā bruvan kiṃ na tyājyaḥ naiva iti brūmaḥ tasya hi pūrṇajñānatvāt eva rāgādyabhāva iti avacanādikaṃ śiṣyagatenaiva kenacit ayogyatvānāśvastatvādinā nimittena syāt iti tadupāsane yatanīyaṃ śiṣyeṇa na tattyāge

lines: Thus caused-by-grace power-descent independent indeed
from-dependence-on-act-and-rest-determinism.
tsa-a11-v23.sanskrit_cite: evam anugrahanimittaṃ śaktipāto nirapekṣa eva karmādiniyatyapekṣaṇāt

lines: Concealment — such the fruit of dependence: deep sorrow, delusion shared.
Like light-freedom's, the awakened one acts the fool; by heart he scorns his foolish act.
Likewise the fool performs awakened acts and scorns them too: his foolish act, even when done of the awakened, goes to destruction.
His awakened act, being scorned — from forbidden-conduct-form and self-suspicion — drowns him in sorrow-delusion mire.
Yet of arisen-power-descent concealment exists also: dependence on act-and-rest as before is prohibited there;
there too, from will-manifoldness, this body-only-sorrow-fruit — or in initiation-covenant-conduct-teacher-fire's service-condemnation-both, like before, of doctrine-abandoners like.
tsa-a11-v24.sanskrit_cite: tirobhāva iti tirobhāvo hi karmādyapekṣagāḍhaduḥkhamohabhāgitvaphalaḥ yathāhi prakāśasvātantryāt prabuddho 'pi mūḍhavat ceṣṭate hṛdayena ca mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ nindati tathā mūḍho 'pi prabuddhaceṣṭāṃ mantrārādhanādikāṃ kuryāt nindec ca yathā ca asya mūḍhaceṣṭā kriyamāṇāpi prabuddhasya dhvaṃsam eti tathā asya prabuddhaceṣṭā sā tu nindyamānā niṣiddhācaraṇarūpatvāt svayaṃ ca tayaiva viśaṅkamānatvāt enaṃ duḥkhamohapaṅke nimajjayati na tu utpannaśaktipātasya tirobhāvo 'sti atrāpi ca karmādyapekṣā pūrvavat niṣedhyā tatrāpi ca icchāvaicitryāt etad dehamātropabhogyaduḥkhaphalatvaṃ vā dīkṣāsamayacaryāgurudevāgnyādau sevānindanobhayaprasaktānām iva prāk śivaśāsanasthānāṃ tattyāginām iva

lines: Even so, from will-manifoldness, concealed — by self or by descent he joins, dead or through kinsman-grace's mouth:
duty-share committed in own self to the Supreme-Lord just — so the self, unmaimed, should see.
tsa-a11-v25.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi icchāvaicitryāt tirobhūto 'pi svayaṃ vā śaktipātena yujyate mṛto vā bandhugurvādikṛpāmukhena ity evaṃ kṛtyabhāgitvaṃ svātmani anusaṃdadhat parameśvara eva iti na khaṇḍitam ātmānaṃ paśyet
